scholarships.title: KTH India Scholarship
scholarships.funding_label: Full tuition waiver + monthly living allowance

existing.description: "Receiving this scholarship has greatly relieved me of the financial burden to pursue my education. It meant freedom for me, and I am honoured to have received this scholarship."
existing.eligibility_summary: Indian applicants admitted to a master's programme at KTH. Applicants from Mumbai and Pune receive priority under the foundation rules, but the scholarship remains open to eligible Indian applicants from other regions. Very competitive (one award offered in 2026).
benefits: Tuition fee coverage for the first and second year, subject to satisfactory first-year study results.
Monthly living allowance during the academic year (10 months).
coverage: fee of a two year master’s programme. In 2026, 9 % of the scholarship applicants admitted to a programme were nominated for the KTH Scholarship (2 out of 23). The foundation is awarding one scholarshi
The tuition fee is charged in advance for each semester and you pay by bank transfer.
More information on tuition fee payment and reimbursement
requirements: The required documents for each programme is listed on the page for Entry requirements .
You can find the specific requirements required for each programme through the links below.
documents: No additional documents are required for the scholarship application; assessment uses documents submitted to universityadmissions.se by the document submission deadline.
existing.english_requirement: English proficiency equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6/English Level 2.
application_method: Before applying for the KTH India Scholarship, you must first apply for a master’s programme at KTH via universityadmissions.se.
How to apply to master's programmes (University Admissions)

If you need help, our official local consultants can support you in applying free of charge.
